You also note that his eyes and mucous membranes were more pale than normal. Concerned for this constellation of signs/symptoms, you order for MRI of his thoracic spine, which reveals a large mass involving the gastric body and extending posteriorly into the spinal column. You also note multiple additional lesions in several distant regions of the thorax.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
